responsibility: Declares the lattice and value-tracking data structures that underpin GCC’s interprocedural constant propagation pass. This header defines the per-parameter propagation model used by ipa-cp.cc, including generic value/source lattices for constants and aggregate pieces, known-bits and value-range lattices, polymorphic-context tracking, and the combined ipcp_param_lattices container that records what is known about each formal parameter and where those facts came from across callgraph edges.
same_name_distinction: This is the companion header for ipa-cp.cc: it defines the IPA-CP lattices, value/source records, and parameter-tracking types that the .cc file’s propagation, profitability, cloning, and transformation logic operates on, rather than implementing the pass driver itself.
